Enum Class ArchiveReads

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<ArchiveReads>
io.micronaut.runner.build.ArchiveReads
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<ArchiveReads>, Constable
public enum ArchiveReads extends Enum<ArchiveReads>
How the launcher reads the runner jar at run time when micronaut.runner.mmap does not say.

The choice is recorded in the index header, so it costs nothing at build time and can be overridden per launch: -Dmicronaut.runner.mmap=full maps the whole archive whatever the packager chose, and -Dmicronaut.runner.mmap=index reads positionally whatever it chose.

Since:
1.0

  • Enum Constant Details

    • MAPPED

      public static final ArchiveReads MAPPED
      Map the whole archive and define every STORED class straight from the mapping.

      This is the default. It starts fastest, but every page a class read touches stays mapped in the process as a clean, file-backed page, so it counts in the process's resident set size until the process exits, although the kernel can drop it at any time.

    • POSITIONAL

      public static final ArchiveReads POSITIONAL
      Map only the index, and read each STORED class with one positional read into a pooled direct buffer.

      The class bytes stay in the page cache and out of the process's resident set, so the RSS that ps and top report is lower, while private memory stays about the same. Each class costs a system call, so startup is slightly slower. DEFLATE classes of a Compression.PRESERVE archive still inflate, from a pooled buffer.
